findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: An attacker could inject malicious input into the file contents, which could be executed as a command due to the use of printf.
findings.assumptions: The file contents are not sanitized before being printed, and the environment allows command execution through printf.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.trigger: An attacker could provide a malicious search pattern that could lead to OS command injection.
findings.assumptions: The search pattern is not sanitized before being used in the glob function, and the environment allows command execution through glob.
